# Segun Samuel

> Segun Samuel is a strategic, intellectual and learning ecosystem connecting frameworks, courses, books, insights, podcast, application and knowledge discovery.

## Primary navigation
- HOME: https://greaterheight.github.io/Thesegunsamuel/
- LEARN: https://greaterheight.github.io/Thesegunsamuel/courses/
- THINK: https://greaterheight.github.io/Thesegunsamuel/frameworks/
- APPLY: https://greaterheight.github.io/Thesegunsamuel/applications/
- LISTEN: https://greaterheight.github.io/Thesegunsamuel/podcast/
- EXPLORE: https://greaterheight.github.io/Thesegunsamuel/explore/

## Core frameworks
- TEA™ — Time, Energy, Attention: resource management.
- FIAGS™ — Fear, Impatience, Anxiety, Greed, Sentiment: emotional and psychological barriers.
- 5PTES™ — People, Processes, Places, Principality, Pains, Times, Events, Seasons: multi-dimensional diagnosis.
- Pattern Intelligence: detecting signals, recognising patterns, interpreting relationships and converting observations into strategic insight.

## Notes
The public website is a static GitHub Pages frontend. Authentication, payment verification, private course access, persistent progress and certificates require a secure backend.
